ABS.description: Returns the absolute value of a number.

ACOS.description: Returns the arc cosine of a number.

ASCIIDELETE.description: Deletes a file from the TM1 server data directory.

ASCIIOUTPUT.description: Appends a delimited line to an ASCII file (filename, value1, value2, ...).

ASIN.description: Returns the arc sine of a number.

ATAN.description: Returns the arc tangent of a number.

ATTRINSERT.description: Creates a dimension attribute after priorAttribute (dimension, priorAttribute, newAttributeName, type: 'String'|'Numeric'|'Alias'). Pass '' as priorAttribute to insert first.

ATTRL.description: Returns a locale-aware element attribute value.

ATTRN.description: Returns a numeric element attribute value.

ATTRPUTN.description: Writes a numeric value to a dimension element attribute.

ATTRPUTS.description: Writes a string value to a dimension element attribute.

ATTRS.description: Returns a string element attribute value.

CANCELJOBS.description: Cancels blocked asynchronous processes (lock wait / Sleep).

CAPIT.description: Capitalises the first letter of each word.

CELLGETN.description: Returns a numeric value from a cube cell.

CELLGETS.description: Returns a string value from a cube cell.

CELLINCREMENTN.description: Increments a numeric cube cell value by the given amount.

CELLISUPDATEABLE.description: Returns 1 if the cell is writeable by the current user.

CELLPUTN.description: Writes a numeric value to a cube cell.

CELLPUTS.description: Writes a string value to a cube cell.

CELLVALUEN.description: Returns a numeric cube cell value (Rules alias for DB).

CELLVALUES.description: Returns a string cube cell value.

CHAR.description: Returns the character for an ASCII code value.

CODE.description: Returns the ASCII code of the character at the given position.

CONSOLIDATECHILDREN.description: Controls whether children of a consolidation are consolidated normally.

CONSOLIDATEDAVG.description: Returns the average value in a consolidation.

CONSOLIDATEDCOUNT.description: Returns the count of values in a consolidation.

CONSOLIDATEDCOUNTUNIQUE.description: Returns the count of unique values in a consolidation.

CONSOLIDATEDMAX.description: Returns the maximum value in a consolidation.

CONSOLIDATEDMIN.description: Returns the minimum value in a consolidation (flag-value + cube + elements).

CONTINUE.description: Passes control to the next matching rule for this cell.

COS.description: Returns the cosine of a number.

CUBEATTRN.description: Returns a numeric cube attribute value.

CUBEATTRS.description: Returns a string cube attribute value.

CUBECREATE.description: Creates a new cube with the specified dimensions.

CUBEDESTROY.description: Deletes a cube and all its data permanently.

CUBEEXISTS.description: Returns 1 if the named cube exists.

CUBEPROCESSFEEDERS.description: Reprocesses all feeders for a cube.

CUBERULEAPPEND.description: Appends a rule string to a cube's existing rules.

CUBERULEDESTROY.description: Deletes all rules from a cube.

CUBESAVEDATA.description: Serialises cube data to disk immediately.

CUBESETLOGCHANGES.description: Enables (1) or disables (0) transaction logging for a cube.

CUBETIMELASTUPDATED.description: Returns the timestamp when the cube data was last updated.

CUBEUNLOAD.description: Unloads a cube from server memory.

DATE.description: Returns a serial date number for a year, month and day.

DATES.description: Converts a serial date number to a date string.

DAY.description: Returns the day of the month from a serial date number.

DAYNO.description: Returns the day number (1-366) for a date string.

DB.description: Returns a numeric value from a cube using the current element context.

DELET.description: Deletes a substring from a string.

DIMENSIONATTRN.description: Returns a numeric dimension attribute value.

DIMENSIONATTRS.description: Returns a string dimension attribute value.

DIMENSIONDELETEALLELEMENTS.description: Deletes all elements from a dimension.

DIMENSIONDELETEELEMENTS.description: Deletes elements matching a wildcard pattern from a dimension.

DIMENSIONDESTROY.description: Deletes a dimension and all associated elements.

DIMENSIONELEMENTCOMPONENTADD.description: Adds a child element to a consolidation.

DIMENSIONELEMENTCOMPONENTADDDIRECT.description: Adds a child to a consolidation directly without buffering.

DIMENSIONELEMENTCOMPONENTDELETE.description: Removes a child from a consolidation.

DIMENSIONELEMENTCOMPONENTDELETEDIRECT.description: Removes a child from a consolidation directly without buffering.

DIMENSIONELEMENTDELETE.description: Deletes an element from a dimension.

DIMENSIONELEMENTDELETEDIRECT.description: Deletes an element directly without buffering.

DIMENSIONELEMENTEXISTS.description: Returns 1 if the element exists in the dimension.

DIMENSIONELEMENTINSERT.description: Inserts an element into a dimension (Metadata procedure).

DIMENSIONELEMENTINSERTDIRECT.description: Inserts an element directly without buffering.

DIMENSIONELEMENTPRINCIPALNAME.description: Returns the principal (canonical) name of an element.

DIMENSIONEXISTS.description: Returns 1 if the named dimension exists.

DIMENSIONHIERARCHYCREATE.description: Creates an alternate hierarchy within a dimension.

DIMENSIONSORTORDER.description: Sets the sort order for elements in a dimension.

DIMENSIONTIMELASTUPDATED.description: Returns the timestamp when the dimension was last modified.

DIMENSIONTOPELEMENTINSERT.description: Inserts an element at the top level of a dimension.

DIMENSIONTOPELEMENTINSERTDIRECT.description: Inserts a top-level element directly without buffering.

DIMENSIONUPDATEDIRECT.description: Commits buffered dimension changes directly to the server.

DIMIX.description: Returns the 1-based index of an element in a dimension.

DIMNM.description: Returns the name of the Nth element in a dimension.

DIMSIZ.description: Returns the number of elements in a dimension.

DNEXT.description: Returns the next element name in a dimension.

DNLEV.description: Returns the number of levels in a dimension.

ELCOMP.description: Returns the Nth component of a consolidated element.

ELCOMPN.description: Returns the number of components of a consolidated element.

ELEMENTATTRN.description: Returns a numeric element attribute value (hierarchy-aware).

ELEMENTATTRPUTN.description: Writes a numeric element attribute value (hierarchy-aware).

ELEMENTATTRPUTS.description: Writes a string element attribute value (hierarchy-aware).

ELEMENTATTRS.description: Returns a string element attribute value (hierarchy-aware).

ELEMENTCOMPONENT.description: Returns the Nth component of a consolidated element (hierarchy-aware).

ELEMENTCOMPONENTCOUNT.description: Returns the number of components of a consolidated element.

ELEMENTCOUNT.description: Returns the total number of elements in a hierarchy.

ELEMENTFIRST.description: Returns the first element name in a hierarchy.

ELEMENTINDEX.description: Returns the 1-based index of an element in a hierarchy.

ELEMENTISANCESTOR.description: Returns 1 if the first element is an ancestor of the second.

ELEMENTISCOMPONENT.description: Returns 1 if the second element is a component of the first.

ELEMENTISPARENT.description: Returns 1 if the first element is a direct parent of the second.

ELEMENTLEVEL.description: Returns the level of an element within a hierarchy (0 = leaf).

ELEMENTNAME.description: Returns the element name at position n in a hierarchy.

ELEMENTNEXT.description: Returns the next element name in a hierarchy.

ELEMENTPARENT.description: Returns the Nth parent of an element in a hierarchy.

ELEMENTPARENTCOUNT.description: Returns the number of parents of an element.

ELEMENTWEIGHT.description: Returns the weight of a child element within a parent in a hierarchy.

ELISANC.description: Returns 1 if the first element is an ancestor of the second.

ELISCOMP.description: Returns 1 if the second element is a component of the first.

ELISPAR.description: Returns 1 if the first element is a direct parent of the second.

ELLEV.description: Returns the level of an element (0 = leaf).

ELPAR.description: Returns the Nth parent of an element.

ELPARN.description: Returns the number of parents of an element.

ELWEIGHT.description: Returns the weight of a child element within a parent.

EXECUTEHTTPREQUEST.description: Executes an HTTP request (method, URL, options…) — response read via HttpResponseGet*.

EXECUTEPROCESS.description: Executes a TI process synchronously; returns 0 on success.

EXP.description: Returns e raised to the power of number.

FILL.description: Repeats or truncates a string to the specified length.

FV.description: Returns the future value of an annuity.

GETJOBSTATUS.description: Returns the status of an asynchronously launched process (job ID).

GETPROCESSERRORFILEDIRECTORY.description: Returns the server error-log directory path. Distinct from GetProcessErrorFilename (which returns the current process's specific error log filename).

GETPROCESSERRORFILENAME.description: Returns the filename of the current process error log.

GETPROCESSNAME.description: Returns the name of the currently executing process.

HIERARCHYCONTAINSALLLEAVES.description: Returns 1 if every leaf in the default hierarchy is present.

HIERARCHYDELETEALLELEMENTS.description: Deletes all elements from a hierarchy.

HIERARCHYDELETEELEMENTS.description: Deletes elements matching a pattern from a hierarchy.

HIERARCHYELEMENTCOMPONENTADD.description: Adds a child to a consolidation in a specific hierarchy.

HIERARCHYELEMENTCOMPONENTADDDIRECT.description: Adds a child to a hierarchy consolidation directly.

HIERARCHYELEMENTCOMPONENTDELETE.description: Removes a child from a consolidation in a specific hierarchy.

HIERARCHYELEMENTCOMPONENTDELETEDIRECT.description: Removes a hierarchy consolidation child directly.

HIERARCHYELEMENTDELETE.description: Deletes an element from a specific hierarchy.

HIERARCHYELEMENTDELETEDIRECT.description: Deletes a hierarchy element directly without buffering.

HIERARCHYELEMENTEXISTS.description: Returns 1 if the element exists in the hierarchy.

HIERARCHYELEMENTINSERT.description: Inserts an element into a specific hierarchy under a parent with a given weight (dimension, hierarchy, parent, element, type).

HIERARCHYELEMENTINSERTDIRECT.description: Inserts a hierarchy element directly without buffering (dimension, hierarchy, parent, element, type).

HIERARCHYEXISTS.description: Returns 1 if the named hierarchy exists on the dimension.

HTTPRESPONSEGETBODY.description: Returns the body of the most recent HTTP response.

HTTPRESPONSEGETHEADER.description: Returns a named header value from the most recent HTTP response.

HTTPRESPONSEGETSTATUSCODE.description: Returns the HTTP status code of the most recent HTTP response.

IF.description: Returns true_value if condition is non-zero, else false_value.

INSRT.description: Inserts a string into another string at a position.

INT.description: Returns the integer portion of a number (truncates toward zero).

ISLEAF.description: Returns 1 if the cell intersection is a leaf cell.

ISUND.description: Returns 1 if the value is undefined.

ISUNDEFINEDCELLVALUE.description: Returns 1 if the value is the undefined cell value marker.

ITEMREJECT.description: Rejects the current datasource record and logs a message (0 or 1 args — the reason string is optional).

ITEMSKIP.description: Skips the current datasource record without logging.

LN.description: Returns the natural logarithm of a number.

LOG.description: Returns the base-10 logarithm of a number.

LOGOUTPUT.description: Writes a message to the process log (severity, message).

LONG.description: Returns the length of a string.

MAX.description: Returns the larger of two numbers.

MIN.description: Returns the smaller of two numbers.

MOD.description: Returns the remainder of number divided by divisor.

MONTH.description: Returns the month from a serial date number.

NEWDATEFORMATTER.description: Creates a date-formatter handle from a format pattern (e.g. 'yyyyMMdd') for use with date-formatting functions. NOT consumed by ParseDate — ParseDate takes the format string directly.

NOW.description: Returns the current server date/time as a serial number.

NUMBERTOSTREX.description: Converts a number to a formatted string (value, length, decimals, separator).

NUMBERTOSTRING.description: Converts a numeric value to a string.

NUMBR.description: Converts a string to a number.

PARSEDATE.description: Parses a date string into a TM1 serial date number (format pattern, date string) — e.g. ParseDate('yyyyMMdd', '20260101'). Both args are plain strings.

PAYMT.description: Returns the payment for a loan.

PROCESSBREAK.description: Stops processing the current datasource record and moves to the Epilog.

PROCESSERROR.description: Marks the process as errored and stops execution.

PROCESSEXISTS.description: Returns 1 if the named process exists.

PROCESSEXITNORMAL.description: Returns the value ExecuteProcess returns on success (0) — compare against a captured ExecuteProcess result to check for failure.

PROCESSQUIT.description: Stops the process immediately without error.

PV.description: Returns the present value of an annuity.

RAND.description: Returns a random number between 0 and 1.

REFRESHMDXHIERARCHY.description: Refreshes a virtual (MDX-driven) hierarchy on a dimension.

ROUND.description: Rounds a number to the specified number of decimal places.

ROUNDP.description: Rounds a number to the specified precision (round-half-up).

RUNPROCESS.description: Executes a TI process in parallel; returns the Job ID.

SAVEDATAALL.description: Saves all cube data to disk immediately.

SCAN.description: Returns the position of the first occurrence of find within within (0 = not found).

SECURITYREFRESH.description: Reloads TM1 security definitions after a user/group change.

SIGN.description: Returns 1, 0, or -1 based on the sign of number.

SIN.description: Returns the sine of a number.

SLEEP.description: Pauses process execution for the given number of milliseconds.

SQRT.description: Returns the square root of a number.

STET.description: Leaves the cell value unchanged; applies natural consolidation.

STR.description: Formats a number as a fixed-width string with specified decimal places.

STRINGTONUMBER.description: Converts a string to a numeric value.

STRINGTONUMEX.description: Converts a formatted string to a number (value, decimals, separator).

SUBSETCREATE.description: Creates an empty static subset on a dimension (dimension, subset name, optional AsTemporary: 1=temporary, 0/omitted=permanent).

SUBSETCREATEBYMDX.description: Creates a dynamic MDX subset (subset name, MDX expression). Unlike other Subset* functions there is no separate dimension argument — the dimension is embedded in the MDX.

SUBSETDESTROY.description: Deletes a static or dynamic subset from a dimension (dimension, subset name).

SUBSETELEMENTDELETE.description: Removes the element at a given 1-based position from a static subset (dimension, subset, position — NOT element name).

SUBSETELEMENTINSERT.description: Inserts an element into a static subset at a given position (dimension, subset, element, position).

SUBSETEXISTS.description: Returns 1 if the named subset exists on the dimension.

SUBSETGETELEMENTNAME.description: Returns the element name at a given 1-based position in a subset.

SUBSETGETSIZE.description: Returns the number of elements in a subset.

SUBSETMDXGET.description: Returns the MDX expression of a dynamic subset.

SUBSETMDXSET.description: Sets the MDX expression of a dynamic subset (dimension, subset, MDX).

SUBST.description: Returns a substring starting at position start.

TABDIM.description: Returns the name of the Nth dimension of a cube.

TAN.description: Returns the tangent of a number.

TEXTOUTPUT.description: Appends a line to a text file (filename, value1, value2, ...).

TIME.description: Returns the current server time as a serial number.

TIMST.description: Formats a serial time/date number using a format string.

TIMVL.description: Returns a unit (year/month/day/hour/minute/second) from a serial number.

TODAY.description: Returns the current date as a serial number (optional day offset).

TRIM.description: Removes leading and trailing whitespace from a string.

UNDEFINEDCELLVALUE.description: Returns the undefined cell value marker.

UNDEFVALS.description: Returns an undefined value, used with IF to leave a cell undefined.

VIEWCONSTRUCT.description: Rebuilds (recalculates) a saved view in memory.

VIEWCREATE.description: Creates a new (empty) native view on a cube.

VIEWDESTROY.description: Deletes a view from a cube.

VIEWEXISTS.description: Returns 1 if the named view exists on the cube.

VIEWEXTRACTSKIPCONSOLIDATEDSTRINGSSET.description: Sets whether strings stored on consolidated values are excluded from a view extract (0=include/default, 1=exclude).

VIEWEXTRACTSKIPZEROESSET.description: Sets whether zero values are skipped when extracting a view (1 = skip, 0 = include).

VIEWSUBSETASSIGN.description: Assigns a named subset to a dimension in a view (cube, view, dimension, subset) — no axis argument.

VIEWZEROOUT.description: Sets every cell in a view to zero.

WAITFORALLJOBS.description: Waits for all of the specified async jobs to complete.

WAITFORANYJOBS.description: Waits for any of the specified async jobs to complete.

WAITFORINTERNALJOBS.description: Waits for all async jobs launched by the current process to complete.

YEAR.description: Returns the year from a serial date number.
